title: Incremental mirror with content hashes
prompt: A backup tool mirrors a source directory to a destination and stores a JSON manifest of hashes. It currently copies only new names, so changed content is stale, and it never removes deleted source files. Fix sync_tree(source, destination) in sync.py. Update changed files, remove files absent from source, keep unchanged files untouched, reject symlinks in source, and avoid writing a manifest until the copy/delete phase succeeds. Run visible tests and validate.
